sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Absent-minded, incoherent, silly and non-
sensical, memory impaired.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Impossible to stand with eyes shut, ten-
dency to fall backwards.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Conjunctivitis, acute and chronic. Mydriasis,
Paralysis of accommodation. Hyperaemia of retina with
weakness of accommodation, fundus red, blood-vessels
full and tortuous ; pupils dilated, with dim vision. Pain
over eye, between it and brow.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Larynx dry, voice hoarse, phonation
difficult. Dry cough with oppressed breathing.

304

sections.label: Extremities
Relationship
sections.text:
Has been used as a substitute for
Atropia in doses of 1-80 to 1-20 of a grain hypoder-
mically. Antidotes : Morphia; Pilocarp. Compare :
Bellad.; Strain,; Hyos.
